llm.summary: The skill is internally consistent with its stated purpose: it requires the hf CLI and a single HF_TOKEN and its runtime instructions match the Hugging Face CLI functionality; exercise caution about token scopes, destructive CLI commands, and the curl|bash install recommendation.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match required artifacts: the SKILL.md expects the official `hf` CLI and the HF_TOKEN environment variable. No unrelated binaries, credentials, or config paths are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions stay on-task (running `hf` commands). They document many destructive/write operations (repo/bucket/endpoint deletion, uploads, jobs) — which is expected for a full-featured HF CLI helper but means the agent (or user) must provide appropriate token scope. The doc also advises adding HF_TOKEN to the shell profile for persistence (this increases risk if the environment is shared).
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no formal install spec (instruction-only). SKILL.md suggests installing via `curl -LsSf https://hf.co/cli/install.sh | bash`. That URL appears to be an official Hugging Face short domain, but piping remote scripts to a shell is a moderate-risk pattern — users should inspect the script before running it.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only HF_TOKEN is required (proportionate). However HF_TOKEN can be scoped to read or write; write-scoped tokens grant broad destructive capabilities documented in the skill. The skill correctly recommends using the env var rather than interactive login, but storing tokens in persistent shell profiles or on shared systems increases exposure.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill is user-invocable; model invocation is allowed (default) which is normal. The skill does not request permanent system-wide modification or other skills' credentials.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says: it runs the official hf CLI and needs HF_TOKEN. Before installing or using it: 1) Prefer providing a read-only HF_TOKEN if you only need to browse/download; give write-scoped tokens only when necessary. 2) Avoid placing tokens in globally readable or shared shell profiles; use ephemeral or scoped credentials when possible. 3) Be aware many documented commands are destructive (delete repo, buckets, endpoints); double-check commands before running. 4) The install suggestion uses `curl | bash` from hf.co — inspect the install script before executing it or install via your OS/package manager if you prefer. 5) If you allow autonomous agent invocation, understand the agent could run hf commands using the provided token; limit token scope accordingly.
